objective: Add a signed-in-only 'Post about this' action to the game page, each played box-score row and each career line on the player page, each a link to FRONTEND-013's pre-filled /compose address for that attachment.
acceptance_criteria: On /games/<id> for a completed game (not both scores 0), a signed-in viewer sees one 'Post about this' link to /compose?link=game_final&ref=<id>; it is absent for a 0-0 game.

Each played box-score row (seconds_played not null) has a 'Post about this' link, labelled with the player's name for assistive technology, to /compose?link=player_game&ref=<line_id>&game=<game id>; did-not-play players have none.

On /players/<id>, the Regular season and Playoffs career rows each have a 'Post about this' link to /compose?link=player_career&ref=<id>&scope=regular or scope=playoffs, absent for a scope with games_played 0.
A signed-out viewer sees none of these links on either page; the pages are otherwise unchanged for them.
Following each link lands on /compose with the matching attachment summary shown (FRONTEND-013's parser), asserted end to end through the route table for all three types.

The games and players features reach compose by address only, never by import (the feature isolation tests pass); the address is built by one helper per feature or one shared helper under src/features/stats/links.ts, not hand-written per link.
Every existing frontend test passes; typecheck, lint and build pass; 0x08-frontend.md and FrontendUI/components.md record the action.

Browser rows (vite preview against backend-dev with seeded data, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide): signed in, each of the three links opens compose pre-filled and the post publishes; signed out, none shows; the box-score link stays reachable in the horizontally scrolling table at 360 wide; focus is visible on each link.
